story.text: 그날 오후, 규현은 나를 근처 작은 카페로 이끌었다. 자리에 앉기도 전에 그는 이미 메뉴판을 살펴보고 있었다.
story.reading: geu-nal o-hu, gyu-hyeon-eun na-reul geun-cheo jak-eun ka-pe-ro i-kkeul-eot-da. ja-ri-e anj-gi-do jeon-e geu-neun i-mi me-nyu-pan-eul sal-pyeo-bo-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: That afternoon, Kyuhyun led me to a small nearby cafe. Before I'd even sat down, he was already looking over the menu.

story.text: '커피 취향 좀 물어봐도 돼요? 아니다, 그냥 제가 알아서 시킬게요. 이런 건 또 은근히 잘하거든요.'
story.reading: keo-pi chwi-hyang jom mul-eo-bwa-do dwae-yo? a-ni-da, geu-nyang je-ga al-a-seo si-kil-ge-yo. i-reon geon tto eun-geun-hi jal-ha-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: "Mind if I ask your coffee preference? Actually, never mind — I'll just order for you. I happen to be pretty good at this kind of thing."

story.text: 잠시 후 그는 내 취향이라고는 하나도 묻지 않았으면서, 신기하게도 딱 내가 좋아할 만한 걸 들고 돌아왔다.
story.reading: jam-si hu geu-neun nae chwi-hyang-i-ra-go-neun ha-na-do mut-ji an-at-eu-myeon-seo, sin-gi-ha-ge-do ttak nae-ga jo-a-hal man-han geol deul-go dol-a-wat-da.
story.en: A little while later, he came back — even though he hadn't asked about my taste at all, he'd somehow brought back exactly the kind of drink I'd like.

story.text: '사심이 조금 섞인 선택이었어요. 아가씨가 달달한 거 좋아할 것 같아서.'
story.reading: sa-sim-i jo-geum seok-in seon-taeg-i-eot-seo-yo. a-ga-ssi-ga dal-dal-han geo jo-a-hal geot gat-a-seo.
story.en: "That choice had a little bit of personal interest mixed in. I had a feeling you'd like something sweet."

story.text: 무심한 듯 던진 말이었지만, 그 안에는 세심한 배려가 묻어 있었다. 그런 다정함이 낯설어서, 나는 잠시 말을 잃었다.
story.reading: mu-sim-han deut deon-jin mal-i-eot-ji-man, geu an-e-neun se-sim-han bae-ryeo-ga mud-eo iss-eot-da. geu-reon da-jeong-ham-i nat-seol-eo-seo, na-neun jam-si mal-eul il-eot-da.
story.en: It sounded like an offhand remark, but there was careful consideration tucked inside it. That kind of warmth felt unfamiliar, and for a moment I didn't know what to say.

story.text: '왜 그렇게 봐요? …이렇게 단둘이 앉아 있는 거, 사실 저도 오랜만이라 좀 어색하네요.' 그는 헛기침을 하며 시선을 창밖으로 돌렸다.
story.reading: wae geu-reo-ke bwa-yo? …i-reo-ke dan-dul-i anj-a it-neun geo, sa-sil jeo-do o-raen-man-i-ra jom eo-saek-ha-ne-yo. geu-neun heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo si-seon-eul chang-bak-eu-ro dol-lyeot-da.
story.en: "Why are you looking at me like that? ...Honestly, sitting like this, just the two of us — it's been a while for me too, so it feels a little awkward." He cleared his throat and turned his gaze out the window.

story.text: 늘 여유롭고 능글맞던 그가 순간 말을 더듬는 모습이 낯설었다. 그리고 그 낯섦이, 묘하게 싫지 않았다.
story.reading: neul yeo-yu-rop-go neung-geul-maj-deon geu-ga sun-gan mal-eul deo-deum-neun mo-seub-i nat-seol-eot-da. geu-ri-go geu nat-seolm-i, myo-ha-ge silh-ji an-at-da.
story.en: Seeing him — always so composed and smooth — stumble over his words for once felt strange. And oddly, I didn't mind that strangeness at all.

words.example_en: There was a little personal interest behind that choice.
We sat at the cafe, just the two of us.
He figured out my taste exactly.
